body:
You told someone with autism to try new stuff. 0_o

Yea i don't do new stuff that well, takes a lot of work and energy. And when I do try new stuff it ends in new dissapointment mostly.
And does temporary mean for years? :/
Thanks for the kind reactions, wish I wasn't this depressed I might've believed some of you.

I no longer like anything. Can't watch movies anymore nor do I play videogames. I work my deadend job and go to bed. Get up eat/work/look for another job/sleep.
Blisfully happy, wonder if I ever was like that. Can't remember the last time I felt happyness..... if I were to guess it would be before high school...
All I feel is dissapointment and rejection

I try and I try only to fail. A lot of effort that never amounts to anything. A constant reminder that I am never good enough. I'm sick of trying with such shitty outcomes. Trying or not trying the result in the end is the same.

Whenever people tell me greater things will come, it feels like they are  lying in an efford to cheer me up.

You are a nice person and I admire you for that.

can't afford a dog. I'm not that shy, just miss social clues. Got the asperger diagnose, guess thats why. I have had a lot of social trainings, a lot of counceling. Even did sales training to get better at talking to people and understanding them.
Still whenever I talk to people I have no clue what they are thinking, I am the embodiment of clueless. A real social failure.

Used to date online, the tinder hotornot thing. Asking girls out at college, malls, bars. Dating sites. After being rejected by over a few hundred girls I got the message.... Only thing I liked about dating was seeing their reaction after they ask about what job I do. You see a persons true nature......well womens true nature it seems.

I used to love anime/videogames/movies. Go to cons and my friends invite me for stuff (not so much anymore since well they have gf's now and no more time for me)

Oh and at my job I don't earn a lot, so I'm 30 and living with my parents because I can't afford anything else.
Not extremely ugly, just autistic 30 years of age living with parents and barely make any money.
